Chapter 6606: Can’T Get There

Chapter 6606: Can’t Get There

However, reaching the maelstrom was easier said than done. Ancestors of regular sects overestimated themselves, let alone junior cultivators.

Once they left Heaven World, they found the vastness of space. They were mere ants attempting to cross the desert despite exerting all of their strength. Traveling from one star to another still took a long time.

Emperors and above could travel ten million miles with one step, shifting from one dimension to another.

“What a waste of time.” One cultivator said. Given his speed, it might take millions of years to get to the maelstrom.

Thus, the majority stopped and watched until the emperors disappeared further ahead.

“Timeglow Emperor, Nature Desolate God, Abyss Ancient Ancestor...” They spotted famous cultivators.

The primal ancestors led the way while others followed like bees. Eventually, the majority gave up and returned to Heaven World.

Unfortunately, the matter wasn’t as simple as anticipated. Once the first group drew closer, they found a mark in space. It was faint as if someone had run out of ink while writing.

Nevertheless, it exerted a crushing pressure on everyone.

“Watch it!” Many became alarmed, summoning their treasures and activating their merit laws.

Colorful radiance erupted as cultivators didn’t hold back.

“Bam!” The pressure sent the treasures flying.

“Ahh!” Weaker emperors and desolate gods screamed and exploded into blood.

Some primal ancestors and heaven-slayers fell like meteors, grievously injured.

“We can’t get there.” Primal ancestors and heaven-slayers became disheartened.

“World Seal is leaving a part of its power here.” A primal ancestor said.

“This is going to be impossible.” A few emperors and desolate gods wanted to leave since they had nearly died.

“An immortal artifact indeed, just a faint mark is frightening.” A heaven-slayer said.

“Activate!” However, one cultivator disagreed and summoned an ancient dao in the form of a portal.

Images of wise sages emerged and an immemorial power rushed out to empower the master.

He wore an official robe and crest, looking transcendent. His dao coiled around him, granting him power and protection.

“Bam!” The portal allowed him to evade the suppression from the mark and reach the center.

“So strong, Antiquity Gateway lives up to its reputation and more.” The others said.

“Grand Preceptor Ancestor is in there.” Another commented.

“One of the oldest.” A powerful primal ancestor commented.

Rumor has it Grand Preceptor was the fourth primal ancestor in Three Immortals. He had met Desolate Ancestor who praised his dao understanding.

He earned everyone’s respect by being the first to make it through the mark. They have heard of him and his gateway before but never saw him in person.

Unfortunately, they could only sigh and watch in disappointment. Meanwhile, Grand Preceptor had a serious expression while gazing at the maelstrom.

Its monstrosity exceeded his imagination.

“Antiquity Reach.” He utilized a technique to shoot out two strands from his dao. They coiled together and formed another portal on the other side with the spring.

“Buzz.” However, a temporal withering power immediately surged toward him.
